origin: A gap in the coordinator's own dispatch. The commission requires the successor-generation test to run on a frozen public suite plus evaluator-held novel cases, and requires that holdout cases be authored by an owner other than the generation author. No owner was ever assigned to author them, so no holdout suite exists. Cohort a8 can therefore never resolve its lift claim and generation-comparison.json is permanently NOT_YET regardless of how well the generations perform.
why_this_is_urgent: G2 now scores 1.0 pass rate and 1.0 critical pass rate on the public suite, against G1 at 0.6774 and G0 at 0.0968. A perfect score on a suite the generation author could read is precisely the signal that evaluator-held novel cases exist to test. Without a holdout, a claim of compounding cannot be distinguished from suite overfitting, and the commission forbids claiming compounding except from measured lift on preregistered metrics.

public_suite_scores_observed.reason_not_yet: no holdout transcript exists for any generation

independence_requirement: The holdout author must be a different owner from the generation author po03-worker-a8 (claude-opus-5-thinking-high) and must author every case without reading a8's generations, its harness or its scoring code. Cases are derived from the commission's acceptance criteria and the frozen contracts only, and are committed and pushed before any generation is read. Git history is the proof.

source_hashes.note: Pinned by commit, per the a12-u02 remediation.

units.hypothesis: A holdout suite can be authored from the commission's acceptance criteria alone, without reading any generation, and will be materially harder than the public suite because it was never available to optimise against.

acceptance.assertion: At least 20 executable novel cases are committed and pushed before any generation source is read, provable from git history. Each case cites the commission requirement it tests, is runnable against any generation through a documented interface, and is not a restatement of a public-suite case. The author confirms in writing that no a8 source was read before the freeze commit.
acceptance.artifact: workstreams/po03/holdout/ suite plus a freeze manifest with hashes
acceptance.falsified_if: git history shows a8 source was read before the freeze, or any case duplicates a public-suite case

units.hypothesis: All three generations can be scored on the holdout using identical inputs and a single scoring path, so the numbers are comparable rather than three separate claims.

acceptance.assertion: G0, G1 and G2 are each scored on the frozen holdout with the same command and the same inputs, transcripts recorded, and the generation identity is withheld from the scorer where the interface permits. Any generation that cannot be scored is reported NOT_SUPPORTED with the exact boundary rather than omitted or given a default.
acceptance.artifact: holdout transcripts per generation plus a comparison table
acceptance.falsified_if: generations are scored by different paths or a failure to score is silently omitted

units.hypothesis: G2's perfect public-suite score reflects suite-specific optimisation rather than general capability, and the holdout will show a materially lower score.

acceptance.assertion: The gap between each generation's public and holdout score is computed and reported. If G2's holdout score is close to its public score the hypothesis is falsified and generalisation is supported, which is a first-class positive result. If the gap is large, the overfitting reading is supported. Either verdict must rest on executed scores, not on inspection of the code.
acceptance.artifact: public-versus-holdout gap analysis with executed scores
acceptance.falsified_if: the verdict rests on reading the generations rather than on scores

units.hypothesis: Whether the commission's compounding claim is established or must remain NOT_YET is decidable from the combined public and holdout evidence.

acceptance.assertion: A single verdict of PASS or NOT_YET is issued on the preregistered lift metric, requiring measured lift on both suites with no quality regression on either, and no regression in false-completion count. The verdict states every input score with its provenance. NOT_YET is an acceptable and expected outcome; a PASS asserted without holdout lift, or with any unreported regression, is a commission failure.
acceptance.falsified_if: a PASS is issued without holdout evidence, or a regression is not reported
